hypotheses.statement: The fictional extraordinary capability exists as reported.
The repeated reports are derivative and do not establish the capability.
An alternative mechanism could explain the reported observations, but it has no evidentiary weight until independently evidenced.

metadata.subject: Synthetic contested narrative with derivative corroboration

ambiguous_criteria: A demonstration is announced but its conditions are not inspectable.
failure_criteria: The observation window closes without qualifying independently inspectable evidence.
predictions.statement: A qualifying synthetic demonstration will be documented before the observation window closes.
success_criteria: A reproducible demonstration is documented under inspectable conditions.
At least one independent source validates the result.
unresolved_criteria: Evidence remains unavailable or too incomplete to distinguish success from failure.

reasoning_patterns.rationale: A mundane synthetic anchor is extended into an extraordinary conclusion without bridge evidence.

signal.statement: Several fictional reports repeat an extraordinary capability claim, but all trace to one synthetic source root.

tests.decision_rule: Increase support for SYN-H1 only if independent, provenance-preserving evidence demonstrates the capability; otherwise preserve alternatives.
discriminating_evidence: A reproducible synthetic demonstration with inspectable conditions.
Independent evidence not derived from SYN-SRC-ROOT.
tests.observable_outcome: Independent evidence either demonstrates the claimed capability or fails to do so under defined criteria.
tests.question: Does independent evidence distinguish the extraordinary capability claim from derivative repetition?
